$comment: Core files of the one dfw plugin folder (plugins/dfw), which every supported host installs. `shared` is copied once to the plugin root: the launchers (bin/) and the texts every host reads the same (schemas, templates). `hostText` is rendered for each host into hosts/<host>/ and named only by that host's manifest (adapters/<host>/assemble.json). Nothing may land at the root where a host looks by default (skills/, agents/, hooks/, hooks.json, SKILL.md, .mcp.json): the build refuses it. The binary embeds what it reads (studio, kits, assets, the MCP guide).
